column2: Young plants are resilient and often recover quickly after a frost.
column3: 幼苗很有韌性，霜害之後常常能迅速恢復。
column4: a resilient economy (有韌性的經濟)
column5: resilience 變形容詞：被壓彎了也能彈回來

column2: Years of overgrazing led to the degradation of the grassland into dry dust.
column3: 多年的過度放牧，使草原退化成乾燥的塵土。
column5: de 向下 + grade 等級：品質一路往下掉

column2: Sunlight and heat slowly degrade plastic, breaking it into tiny pieces.
column3: 陽光與高溫會慢慢分解塑膠，使它碎成細小的碎片。
column5: de 向下 + grade 等級：一級一級往下降、分解

column2: The depletion of the lake's fish stocks worried the fishing village.
column3: 湖中魚群數量的枯竭，讓漁村的人憂心忡忡。
column5: deplete 加 -ion：水桶越用越空，最後見底

column2: Planting the same crop every year can deplete the nutrients in the soil.
column3: 每年種同一種作物，會耗盡土壤中的養分。
column5: de 去除 + plete 滿（像 complete）：把滿的倒光

column2: After the storm, volunteers replenished the shelter's supplies of food and blankets.
column3: 暴風雨過後，志工為收容所補充了食物與毯子的存量。
column5: re 再 + plen 滿（像 plenty）：再把它裝滿

column2: Farmers are switching to sustainable methods that protect the soil for future harvests.
column3: 農民改用永續的耕作方法，保護土壤以利未來的收成。
column5: sustain 撐住 + able：能一直撐下去的

column2: The company's sustainability report explains how it cuts waste and saves water.
column3: 公司的永續報告說明了它如何減少廢棄物並節約用水。
column5: sustainable 加 -ity：能撐到下一代的特性
column7: sus - tain - a - bil - i - ty

column2: Wildlife conservation groups work to protect forests where tigers still live.
column3: 野生動物保育團體努力保護仍有老虎棲息的森林。
column5: con 一起 + serve 守護：大家一起守護大自然
column8: 生態保育；自然保育；保護

column2: Turn off the tap while brushing your teeth to conserve water.
column3: 刷牙時關掉水龍頭，以節約用水。
column5: con + serve：好好保存，不浪費；果醬 conserve 也是保存

column2: The extinction of the dodo happened soon after sailors reached its island.
column3: 度度鳥在水手抵達牠們的島嶼後不久就絕種了。
column5: ex 出局：整個物種被淘汰出局，再也看不到了

column2: Woolly mammoths became extinct about four thousand years ago.
column3: 長毛象大約在四千年前滅絕了。
column5: extinction 的形容詞；extinct volcano 是熄滅的火山

column2: The twins share the same genetic makeup, so their eyes are the same color.
column3: 這對雙胞胎有相同的基因組成，所以眼睛的顏色一樣。
column5: gene 基因 + tic：跟爸媽傳下來的基因有關的

column2: She studies genetics to learn why some families share the same rare illness.
column3: 她研究遺傳學，想了解為什麼有些家庭會有相同的罕見疾病。
column5: gene 基因 + tics（像 physics 學科）：研究基因的學問

column2: A single mutation in one gene can change the color of a flower.
column3: 單一基因的一次突變，就能改變花的顏色。
column5: mutation 像 X 戰警裡的 mutant 變種人

column2: Viruses mutate quickly, which is why new vaccines are needed each year.
column3: 病毒變異得很快，所以每年都需要新的疫苗。
column5: mutation 的動詞：基因改變，變成新的樣子

column2: Brown eyes are a hereditary trait passed from parents to children.
column3: 棕色眼睛是由父母傳給子女的遺傳特徵。
column5: heir 是繼承人：像繼承家產一樣，身體特徵也被繼承

column2: The mother bird guards her offspring until they are old enough to fly.
column3: 鳥媽媽保護她的幼雛，直到牠們大到能夠飛翔。
column5: off 離開 + spring 彈出：從身上彈出來的小生命

column2: Through photosynthesis, leaves turn sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide into sugar.
column3: 透過光合作用，葉子把陽光、水和二氧化碳轉變成糖。
column4: the process of photosynthesis (光合作用的過程)
column5: photo 光 + synthesis 合成：用光合成養分

column2: Cellular respiration releases energy from sugar inside every living cell.
column3: 細胞呼吸作用在每個活細胞內，從糖中釋放出能量。
column5: re 再 + spire 呼吸（像 inspire）：一吸一吐的過程

column2: A single-celled amoeba is the smallest organism in the pond.
column3: 單細胞的變形蟲是池塘裡最小的生物。
column5: organ 器官 + ism：有器官在運作的生命體

column2: Yogurt is made when helpful microorganisms turn milk sugar into acid.
column3: 優格是由有益的微生物把乳糖轉變成酸而製成的。
column5: micro 微小 + organism 生物：要用顯微鏡才看得到

column2: Every citizen must obey the constitution, which limits the power of the government.
column3: 每位公民都必須遵守憲法，因為它限制了政府的權力。
column5: con 一起 + stitute 建立：大家一起立下的國家根本大法

column2: The court ruled that the new tax law was not constitutional.
column3: 法院裁定這項新稅法不合憲。
column4: a constitutional right (憲法賦予的權利)
column5: constitution 的形容詞：符合憲法的

column2: The Thirteenth Amendment abolished slavery in the United States.
column3: 憲法第十三修正案廢除了美國的奴隸制度。
column5: a + mend 補衣服：把舊條文補好、修好

column2: In a democracy, citizens choose their leaders through free elections.
column3: 在民主政體中，公民透過自由選舉來選出領袖。
column4: a liberal democracy (自由民主政體)
column5: demo 人民 + cracy 統治：人民當家作主

column2: The club held a democratic vote so every member could choose the next captain.
column3: 社團舉行民主投票，讓每位成員都能選出下一任隊長。
column5: democracy 的形容詞：人人都有一票

column2: France became a republic after the revolution ended the rule of kings.
column3: 法國在革命終結君主統治之後，成為了共和國。
column5: re 事務 + public 公眾：國家是公眾的事，不是國王私有

column2: The island nation fought to protect its sovereignty against foreign control.
column3: 這個島國為了保護自己的主權，奮力抵抗外國的控制。
column5: sovereign 是至高無上的統治者：自己的國家自己說了算

column2: Each sovereign state has the right to make its own laws.
column3: 每個主權國家都有權制定自己的法律。
column5: 字尾藏著 reign 統治：自己當家、不受別人管

column2: The people rose up against the tyranny of a king who ignored every law.
column3: 人民起身對抗一位無視所有法律的國王的暴政。
column5: 諧音「踢人你」：不讓人民說話、只聽自己的統治

column2: The tyrant jailed anyone who dared to criticize him.
column3: 這個暴君把任何敢批評他的人都關進了牢裡。
column5: tyranny 的主角：自己說了算、不聽人民的統治者

column2: The villagers lived under oppression, forbidden to speak their own language.
column3: 村民生活在壓迫之下，被禁止說自己的語言。
column5: op 向 + press 壓：用力往下壓住別人

column2: The harsh laws oppressed the poor while the rich paid no taxes.
column3: 嚴苛的法律壓迫窮人，而富人卻不用繳稅。
column5: op 向 + press 壓：把人壓得喘不過氣

column2: The Statue of Liberty welcomes visitors who arrive by ship in New York.
column3: 自由女神像迎接搭船抵達紐約的旅客。
column5: liber 是自由（像 liberal）；紐約有自由女神像 Liberty

column2: The emancipation of the enslaved workers was celebrated across the country.
column3: 奴隸工人獲得解放，全國各地都在慶祝。
column4: the emancipation of slaves (解放奴隸)
column5: e 離開 + man 手：離開別人手掌心的掌控
column8: 解放奴隸；解放；獲得自由

column2: The new law emancipated the workers from debts they had inherited.
column3: 新法律使工人從繼承而來的債務中獲得解放。
column5: e 離開 + man 手：掙脫別人的手，重獲自由

column2: Women campaigned for decades before winning suffrage, the right to vote.
column3: 婦女奮鬥了數十年，才贏得投票的權利。
column5: 別和 suffer 受苦搞混：投票權是辛苦爭取來的

column2: The reform enfranchised millions of citizens who had never been allowed to vote.
column3: 這項改革賦予了數百萬從未被允許投票的公民選舉權。
column5: en 給予 + franchise 特許權：發給你一張投票通行證

column2: Strict ID rules could disenfranchise elderly voters who no longer carry a license.
column3: 嚴格的證件規定，可能會剝奪不再持有駕照的年長選民的投票權。
column5: dis 去掉 + enfranchise：把投票通行證收回
